title.zh: Agent Loop：三个关键不变量与工具执行顺序
title.en: Agent Loop: Three Critical Invariants and Tool Execution Order

summary.zh: ki 的 Agent loop 不只是简单的 "调用 LLM → 执行工具 → 重复"。它维护了三个关键不变量：工具执行顺序、截断失败、以及延迟更新抑制。本文深入解析这些设计决策。
summary.en: ki's Agent loop is not just a simple "call LLM → execute tools → repeat". It maintains three critical invariants: tool execution order, truncate-fail, and late-update suppression. This article dives into these design decisions.
